paite: Huan kumpipa'n mi asawl a, akiang ah Juda leh Jerusalem khopi a upa tengteng asamkhawm uhi.
heading: Josiah In Biakna Dik Lou Ahihsia / (2 Kro 34.3-7,29-33)
english: The king sent, and they gathered to him all the elders of Judah and of Jerusalem.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa Judah gam a mi tengteng leh Jerusalem a mi tengteng toh, siampute leh zawlneite toh, mipi tengteng toh, aneu leh alian in TOUPA' inn ah ahohtou ua; TOUPA' inn a kimu thukhun laibu a tuang thu tengteng abil ua zak in asim hi.
english: The king went up to Yahweh’s house, and all the men of Judah and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem with him—with the priests, the prophets, and all the people, both small and great; and he read in their hearing all the words of the book of the covenant which was found in Yahweh’s house.

paite: Khuam zul ah kumpipa adingh a, huai laibu a tuang thukhun thu hihkip ding in lungtang tengteng leh akha tengteng a TOUPA zui ding leh athupiakte, athu theihsakte, adan thusehte zui ding in TOUPA ma ah thu akhung a; huchi in mipi tengteng in leng akhunpih uhi.
english: The king stood by the pillar and made a covenant before Yahweh to walk after Yahweh and to keep his commandments, his testimonies, and his statutes with all his heart and all his soul, to confirm the words of this covenant that were written in this book; and all the people agreed to the covenant.

paite: Kumpipa'n siampu lianpen Hilkiah leh azom a siampute, kongkhak veng mite kiang ah TOUPA tempul sung a Baal, Asherah leh van a om tengteng a dia kibawl tui-um belsuan tengteng lakhe vek ding in thu apia hi. Huchi in Jerusalem polam, Kidron mun ah huai tengteng ahal a, avute Bethel ah apaipih hi.
english: The king commanded Hilkiah the high priest, and the priests of the second order, and the keepers of the threshold, to bring out of Yahweh’s temple all the vessels that were made for Baal, for the Asherah, and for all the army of the sky; and he burned them outside of Jerusalem in the fields of the Kidron, and carried their ashes to Bethel.

paite: Milim pathian bia siampute, Judah Kumpipate'n Judah gam khopi mun sangte a, Jerusalem kim a gimlim hal dia ana seh uh atawpsak a; Baal a dia, ni a dia, kha a dia, aksite a dia van a omte tengteng a dia gimlim hal mite leng.
english: He got rid of the idolatrous priests whom the kings of Judah had ordained to burn incense in the high places in the cities of Judah and in the places around Jerusalem; those also who burned incense to Baal, to the sun, to the moon, to the planets, and to all the army of the sky.

paite: TOUPA' inn a Asherah pen Jerusalem polam Kidron lui a lakhia in ahal a, asiknengawp a, anen mi vantangte han ah atheh hi.
english: He brought out the Asherah from Yahweh’s house, outside of Jerusalem, to the brook Kidron, and burned it at the brook Kidron, and beat it to dust, and cast its dust on the graves of the common people.

paite: Asherah a dia puan gan numeite omna, TOUPA' inn kiang a pasal kizuakte omna innte aphelkhe vek hi.
english: He broke down the houses of the male shrine prostitutes that were in Yahweh’s house, where the women wove hangings for the Asherah.

paite: Judah khopi a pan siampu tengteng apikhia a, siampute'n gimlim ahalna uh Geba a pan Beer-sheba pha in ahihbuah vek a; khopi kongpi veilam pang a om khopi ukpa Joshua kongpi ah alut a kongpite a mun sangte achimsak hi.
english: He brought all the priests out of the cities of Judah, and defiled the high places where the priests had burned incense, from Geba to Beersheba; and he broke down the high places of the gates that were at the entrance of the gate of Joshua the governor of the city, which were on a man’s left hand at the gate of the city.

paite: Mun sang siampute Jerusalem a TOUPA maitam ah ahohtou kei ua, himahleh a-unaute uh lak ah tanghou silngou soh louh ane uhi.
english: Nevertheless the priests of the high places didn’t come up to Yahweh’s altar in Jerusalem, but they ate unleavened bread among their brothers.

paite: Kuamah in atapa hiam atanu hiam Molek kiang a mei a apaisuaksak nawnlouhna ding in, Hinnom suante phaizang a Tophet ahihbuah hi.
english: He defiled Topheth, which is in the valley of the children of Hinnom, that no man might make his son or his daughter to pass through the fire to Molech.

paite: TOUPA' inn lutna a inn huangsung a kumpipa' inn vengmi Nathan-melek dantan chin a Judah kumpipate'n nisa a dia sakol apiakte uh alamang vek a; nisa kangtalai mei in ahal hi.
english: He took away the horses that the kings of Judah had dedicated to the sun, at the entrance of Yahweh’s house, by the room of Nathan Melech the officer who was in the court; and he burned the chariots of the sun with fire.

paite: Ahaz inn chial tung a Judah kumpipate'n maitam abawlte uh leh Manasseh in TOUPA' inn huangsung intual nih a maitam abawlte kumpipa'n ahihchim a, ahihnen vek a, anente Kidron lui ah apai hi.
english: The king broke down the altars that were on the roof of the upper room of Ahaz, which the kings of Judah had made, and the altars which Manasseh had made in the two courts of Yahweh’s house, and beat them down from there, and cast their dust into the brook Kidron.

paite: Jerusalem ma a tatsiatna tang taklam pang a Zidonte pathian kihhuai mahmah Astoreth a dia, Ammon suante pathian kihhuai mahmah Khemosh a dia, Ammonte Pathian kihhuai mah Molek Israel kumpipa Solomon in mun sang abawlte kumpipa'n ahihbuah hi.
english: The king defiled the high places that were before Jerusalem, which were on the right hand of the mountain of corruption, which Solomon the king of Israel had built for Ashtoreth the abomination of the Sidonians, and for Chemosh the abomination of Moab, and for Milcom the abomination of the children of Ammon.

paite: Milimte akitamsak vek a, Ashera ahihpuk a, huai munte ah mihing guhte akoih hi.
english: He broke in pieces the pillars, cut down the Asherah poles, and filled their places with men’s bones.

paite: Huai lou leng Israelte thil hihkhialsakpa Nebat tapa Jeroboam in Bethel a maitam leh Israelte thil hihkhialsakpa Nebat tapa Jeroboam in abawl mun sang, huai maitam ahihchim a mun sang mei ahal in asikzan a, Ashera ahal hi.
english: Moreover the altar that was at Bethel and the high place which Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin, had made, even that altar and the high place he broke down; and he burned the high place and beat it to dust, and burned the Asherah.

paite: Josiah akihei a, tang a hante amu a; huchi in han a guhte ava lasak a, huai thu Pathian mipa'n ana gen, TOUPA thu bangbang in maitam tung ah ahal a, ahihbuah hi.
english: As Josiah turned himself, he spied the tombs that were there in the mountain; and he sent, and took the bones out of the tombs, and burned them on the altar, and defiled it, according to Yahweh’s word which the man of God proclaimed, who proclaimed these things.

paite: Huchi in ama'n, "Huai a ka muh kua suangphuh ahia?" achi a; khomite'n, “Pathian mipa, Judah gam a pan hong pai, Bethel a maitam tung a tua na hih a na genkholpa han ei ve," chi in ahilh uhi.
english: Then he said, “What monument is that which I see?” The men of the city told him, “It is the tomb of the man of God who came from Judah and proclaimed these things that you have done against the altar of Bethel.”

paite: Ama'n, "Bangmah chih kei un; kuamah in aguhte lasuan kei hen," achi hi. Huchi in aguhte Samaria gam a pan zawlnei hong paipa guhte toh bangmah achih kei uhi.
english: He said, “Let him be! Let no one move his bones.” So they let his bones alone, with the bones of the prophet who came out of Samaria.

paite: Israel Kumpipate'n TOUPA hehsak dia alam uh Samaria gam khua a mun sang inn tengteng leng Josiah in asuanmang a, Bethel a ahih vek bang geih in ahih hi.
english: All the houses also of the high places that were in the cities of Samaria, which the kings of Israel had made to provoke Yahweh to anger, Josiah took away, and did to them according to all the acts that he had done in Bethel.

paite: Huchi in huai a mun sang siampu tengteng maitam tung ah athat a, huaite ah mihing guhte ahal a, Jerusalem ah akik nawnta hi.
english: He killed all the priests of the high places that were there, on the altars, and burned men’s bones on them; and he returned to Jerusalem.

paite: Kumpipa'n mi tengteng kiang ah, "Hiai thukhun bu a tuang bang in TOUPA, Pathian a ding in Paikan Ankuang zang un," chi in thu apia hi.
heading: Josiah In Paikan Kut Azang / (2 Kro 35.1-19)
english: The king commanded all the people, saying, “Keep the Passover to Yahweh your God, as it is written in this book of the covenant.”

paite: Israelte tung a vaihawm mite'n vai ahawm ua kipan Israel kumpipa tengteng, Judah kumpipate lal sung hun teng in huchibang hial Paikan Ankuang azang ngei nai kei uhi.
english: Surely there was not kept such a Passover from the days of the judges who judged Israel, nor in all the days of the kings of Israel, nor of the kings of Judah;

paite: Kumpipa Josiah lal akum sawm-le-giatna kum in Jerusalem ah TOUPA a ding in hiai bang in Paikan Ankuang anei phet uhi.
english: but in the eighteenth year of King Josiah, this Passover was kept to Yahweh in Jerusalem.

paite: Huai ban ah TOUPA' inn a siampu Hilkiah in amuh laibu a thu tuangte akipsak theihna ding in dawi aisan siam zawlte, bumsiamte, pathian limte, Judah gam leh Jerusalem a thilkihhuai amuh tengteng Josiah in ahihmang vek hi.
heading: Josiah In Akhek Dangte
english: Moreover, Josiah removed those who had familiar spirits, the wizards, and the teraphim, and the idols, and all the abominations that were seen in the land of Judah and in Jerusalem, that he might confirm the words of the law which were written in the book that Hilkiah the priest found in Yahweh’s house.

paite: Mosi Dan tengteng alungtang leh kha tengteng leh hatna tengteng a TOUPA pom amah bang mahmah ama a kumpipate kuamah a-om kei ua; anung in leng amah bang kuamah a-om nawn sam kei hi.
english: There was no king like him before him, who turned to Yahweh with all his heart, and with all his soul, and with all his might, according to all the law of Moses; and there was none like him who arose after him.

paite: Huchipi in leng TOUPA'N athangpaihna thupi mahmah, Manasseh in ana thangpaihsakna tengteng ziak in Judah tung a athangpaihna akiheisan kei hi.
english: Notwithstanding, Yahweh didn’t turn from the fierceness of his great wrath, with which his anger burned against Judah, because of all the provocation with which Manasseh had provoked him.

paite: TOUPA'N, “Israel ka suanmang bang in Judah leng ka muhphaklouhna ah ka suanmang sam dia, hiai khua ka tel Jerusalem ngei leh huai a inn ka min a-omna ding, ka chih ka paimang ding," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said, “I will also remove Judah out of my sight, as I have removed Israel; and I will cast off this city which I have chosen, even Jerusalem, and the house of which I said, ‘My name shall be there.’”

paite: Huchi in Josiah tanchin dangte, athilhih tengteng Judah kumpipate khangthubute ah tuang ahi kei maw?
heading: Josiah Vaihawm Tawpna / (2 Kro 35.20-36.1)
english: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

paite: Amah alal lai in Assuria kumpipa dou ding in Euphrates Luipi ah Aigupta kumpipa Pharaoh Neko ahohtou hi. Kumpipa Josiah in amah ana dou a; ama'n amuhtak in Meggiddo ah athat hi.
english: In his days Pharaoh Necoh king of Egypt went up against the king of Assyria to the river Euphrates; and King Josiah went against him, but Pharaoh Necoh killed him at Megiddo when he saw him.

paite: Huchi in asikhate'n Meggiddo a pan aluang kangtalai in apaipih ua, Jerusalem ah alutpih ua, ama han ah avui uh. Huchi in huai gam a mite'n Josiah tapa Jehoahaz api ua, thau anilh ua, apa sik in kumpipa in abawlta uhi.
english: His servants carried him dead in a chariot from Megiddo, brought him to Jerusalem, and buried him in his own tomb. The people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah, and anointed him, and made him king in his father’s place.

paite: Jehoahaz alal pat tung in kum sawmnih-le-thum a upa ahi a; Jerusalem ah kha thum sung alal a; anu min Hemutal, Libnah a Jeremiah tanu ahi.
heading: Judah Kumpipa Jehoahaz / (2 Kro 36.2-4)
english: Jehoahaz was twenty-three years old when he began to reign; and he reigned three months in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

paite: Api-le-pute hih bang in TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou mahmah ahih hi.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, according to all that his fathers had done.

paite: Pharaoh Neko in Jerusalem a vaihawm thei nawn lou ding in Hamath gam a Riblah ah akoltangsak a; agam uh dangka talent zakhat leh dangka-eng talent khat siah akipesak hi.
english: Pharaoh Necoh put him in bonds at Riblah in the land of Hamath, that he might not reign in Jerusalem; and put the land to a tribute of one hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold.

paite: Pharaoh Neko in Josiah tapa Eliakim, apa Josiah sik in alalsak a, amin Jehoiakim chi in akheksak hi. Jehoahaz bel apimang a; Aigupta gam ah apai a, huai ah asita hi.
english: Pharaoh Necoh made Eliakim the son of Josiah king in the place of Josiah his father, and changed his name to Jehoiakim; but he took Jehoahaz away, and he came to Egypt and died there.

paite: Jehoiakim in dangka leh dangka-eng Pharaoh ape phot a; himahleh Pharaoh thupiak bang a dangka apiakna ding in agam siah aliausak hi. Pharaoh Neko kiang a piak ding in michih liau dia aseh zah chiat bang in huai gam a mite dangka leh dangka-eng aliausak hi.
heading: Judah Kumpipa Jehoiakim / (2 Kro 36.5-8)
english: Jehoiakim gave the silver and the gold to Pharaoh; but he taxed the land to give the money according to the commandment of Pharaoh. He exacted the silver and the gold of the people of the land, from everyone according to his assessment, to give it to Pharaoh Necoh.

paite: Jehoiakim alal pat tung in kum sawmnih-le-nga a upa ahi a; Jerusalem ah kum sawm-le-khat alal a; anu min Zebudah, Rumah a Pedaiah tanu ahi.
english: Jehoiakim was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Zebidah the daughter of Pedaiah of Rumah.

paite: Huchi in api-le-pute hihdan bang in TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou mahmah ahih hi.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, according to all that his fathers had done.
